component.name: Grok Monitor
component.summary: Shared Grok usage, once per account, in the COSMIC panel

description.p: A panel applet for the COSMIC™ desktop that shows the shared weekly Grok usage pool once per configured account. Grok Build and Grok Bot draw from that pool. Sign in from each icon.
This unofficial applet reads each configured CLI home and calls the Grok CLI billing endpoint. Sign-in uses the Grok CLI device-code flow for that home. It is not affiliated with xAI.
Show only configured account icons. Sign in from each icon with a device code for that icon's CLI home. The default icons are Grok (sim sys) and Grok (pers).
Show the shared weekly pool once per account. The work account is labeled sim sys and the personal account is labeled pers. Remove the retired Grok Bot Monitor applet from the panel.
Version bump to match the shared applet package.
Report when weekly credits will run out in the Build popup.
Show weekly usage pace (on track / ahead / behind) in the Build popup.
Replace personal machine examples in docs and tests with generic placeholders.
Grok Bot Monitor reads accounts from every Grok Bot* config directory.
